notes: OrbitSynth 1.0.1 - editor fix. The 1.0.0 build was compiled without the HAVE_DGL define, so DPF silently built it as a no-UI plug-in and the editor window never opened in FL Studio (audio was unaffected). 1.0.1 restores the full editor: preset browser, filter/envelope graphs, playable keyboard. Audio engine unchanged - all 68 presets, tuning and polyphony re-verified identical.
